title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1983-10-15
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi DR-1)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp 24/96 > Adobe Audition 3.01 > TLH flac2496
source: Mark Cohen's  Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony D5 > Sony D5 (patched out of Barry Glassberg)

ai_review.summary: A sick source captures both sets flowing like hot magma, highlighted by Jerry’s moon‑bound solo on “Big Railroad Blues”.
ai_review.review: Both sets are described as molten and seamless, delivering an exhilarating ride that culminates in a laugh‑out‑loud, over‑the‑top performance of “Big Railroad Blues” where Jerry Garcia soars. The recording is praised as a “sick source,” indicating excellent fidelity and clarity throughout the show.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave 5‑star ratings, lauding the musical flow and Jerry’s standout guitar work while also emphasizing the high‑quality source; this signals an outstanding show with excellent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a “sick source,” implying clear, well‑balanced audio with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Both sets are praised for flowing like hot magma down a mountain into the Pacific, indicating a seamless and dynamic progression.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His playing on “Big Railroad Blues” is called out as "going to the moon" and over‑the‑top, providing a comedic yet masterful highlight.
